name: Igbo
caution: Very small lexicon (3,634 reference words). The generators mostly recombine fragments of existing words, the attested-cluster filter is very restrictive, and neighbourhood measures are coarse; treat results as illustrative. 0.0 million words, versus hundreds of millions for the main languages. Frequency values are unreliable, so there are no frequency bands, only the all-words generators. 2,818 of the reference words come from a Wikipedia corpus (Leipzig Corpora Collection, ibo_wikipedia_2021_10K, 0.2 million words); 816 come from the subtitle list. Written sources are more formal than subtitles and contain more names and foreign words (133 probable English words were removed). Frequencies of the corpus-only words come from that corpus and are not comparable with subtitle frequencies.
source: FILMS/OPUS subtitle frequency list: *.word.pron-one_col-default.filtered_by_pron.spell_checked.zipf_4.tsv; Leipzig Corpora Collection word list ibo_wikipedia_2021_10K (CC BY; Goldhahn, Eckart & Quasthoff 2012)

english_contamination_removed.rule: Leipzig-only words of 5+ letters that are English words with Zipf >= 4.5

reference_lexicon: plain words (alphabet only) with Zipf >= 2.0 and corpus count >= 3

model.trigram_variants: plain maximum-likelihood letter trigrams with two start markers and one end marker; type counts (each word once) or token counts (each word weighted by its per-million frequency)

filters.not_a_corpus_form: rejected if it occurs anywhere in the corpus word list
filters.phonotactic_legality: initial, medial and final consonant clusters and vowel sequences must each occur in >= 3 reference words

metrics.old20: mean Levenshtein distance to the 20 closest reference words
metrics.logprob: mean log2 probability per letter (incl. word end); model = generating model, all = all-words model

generation.target_rule: per generator and training set: number of training words, between 5000 and 40000
